text: At N=128 the force margin is still rising at step 3000 (+0.004 to +0.006 per 500 steps), while accel_step has levelled off since about step 1500. If seeds 20-21 at N=64, 128 and 256 are trained to 6000 steps, does the N=128 force margin reach the N=64 band (>= 0.20)? That would say whether the decline with N is a slower growth rate or a lower ceiling.
